forensic_summary.result: Architected the mechanical system for the world's first automated Makeline. Shifted from component design to 'System Architecture,' treating the assembly as a physical network topology. Intervened to decouple the 'Payload Modules' (Dispensers) from the 'Chassis,' allowing parallel development and scaling. Built the 'Iron Bird' integration rig to validate 48V/CAN bus loads before steel fabrication.
